label: B25-LOGIC-IMM-QUARTUS-SAFE-RTL
title: Rewrite AArch64 logical-immediate decoding into a Quartus-safe pure expression
scope: Replace the output-argument/local-temporary logical-immediate decoder with a pure, fully assigned Quartus-safe return value and fixed-width selection. Preserve every valid/reserved AArch64 encoding and all public pipeline latency/interfaces.
implementation_constraints: No output/inout function argument for the mask and no partially driven automatic local returned to always_comb.
Every returned valid and mask bit is assigned on every path; avoid variable-step loops, break-dependent priority and undefined full-width shifts.
Keep W-form zero-extension and X-form 64-bit masks exact; reserved encodings remain d.valid=0.
Do not modify dmem, load/writeback, firmware, QSF/SDC, tests or expected results in this lane.
acceptance: Existing decode/ISA L0-L2 and lint pass in the isolated worktree; independent exhaustive or broad reference comparison covers valid/reserved logical immediates; the exact A43F masks produce A43F and 3F. Quartus semantic/warning acceptance is owned by T-023 and the merged batch.
resource: Use local only; any heavy generated test must hold resource-lock local. Do not access GamePC or board in this lane.
forbidden_regions: firmware, QSF, SDC, testbench, runner, expected-result or registry changes
disabling assertions, weakening UDEF checks or special-casing only the two firmware opcodes

dispatch.monitoring: event-driven, up to one-hour waits, no frequent polling

result.rtl: PASS; pure 65-bit return, all paths assigned, no output argument/break/variable-step/full-width shift
